auth_method.tooltip: Some workspaces do not let members create personal API keys. Browser sign-in works in those, and never puts a long-lived credential in this window.

api_key.tooltip: Create one under Linear, Settings, Security and access, Personal API keys. Cinnamon stores desklet settings unencrypted, so this key is readable by anything running as your user. Use a key you are willing to revoke.

oauth_connect.tooltip: Opens Linear in your browser to authorize this desklet. The access it grants expires and is renewed automatically.

oauth_disconnect.tooltip: Forgets the stored access and asks Linear to revoke it.

max_issues.tooltip: How many of your assigned issues to list. Completed and cancelled issues are never included.

show_focus_card.tooltip: Gives the top issue a larger tinted card so the next thing to work on stands out from the list.

sort_mode.tooltip: Issues with no priority sort last rather than first, matching how Linear itself orders them.

group_by_team.tooltip: Adds a small team heading above each run of issues. Useful across several teams, noise on one.

imminent_days.description: Treat a due date as imminent within
imminent_days.tooltip: Controls how early the glow starts to intensify. Overdue issues are always at full intensity. Set to 0 to react only on the due day itself.

mention_scope.tooltip: Only true mentions are listed either way. Assignments, status changes and plain replies stay out of this tab.

unread_only.tooltip: Linear cannot filter by read state on the server, so this hides already-read mentions after they arrive.

mark_read_on_click.description: Mark a mention read when you open it
mark_read_on_click.tooltip: Clears the mention from your Linear inbox as well, exactly as opening it in Linear would.

desklet_width.tooltip: Narrow layouts stack each row onto two lines and drop the supporting detail.

scale.tooltip: Scales every text size and spacing together.

density.tooltip: How much breathing room to leave around each element.

show_header.description: Show the heading and refresh time
show_header.tooltip: The heading also carries the unread mention count.

default_tab.tooltip: Which tab to show when the desklet starts.

color_mode.tooltip: Priority runs urgent through to none across the warm end of the palette. The Linear option borrows each workflow state's own colour and brightens it until it is readable on the desklet surface.

surface_opacity.tooltip: Fluent acrylic works best somewhere between 0.55 and 0.85. Set to 0 for a fully transparent surface.

glow.tooltip: Soft neon bloom around the issue in focus and around unread mentions.

tint_surface.description: Tint surfaces with the accent colour
tint_surface.tooltip: Bleeds a little of the accent into the card and row backgrounds.

dark_surface.tooltip: Turn off for a light acrylic surface on a pale wallpaper.

refresh_minutes.tooltip: One request per refresh. A personal API key allows 1500 requests an hour, so even the fastest setting here uses a small fraction of it.

http_timeout.tooltip: Give up on a request that does not respond within this time and keep showing the last result.

click_action.tooltip: Clicking an issue or a mention always opens that item, whatever this is set to.

oauth_port.tooltip: During sign-in the desklet briefly listens on this port, on 127.0.0.1 only, to receive Linear's reply. It tries each in turn by default. Only these ports work, because Linear requires the exact address to be registered in advance.

oauth_client_id.tooltip: Leave empty to use the desklet's own application. Set this only if you have registered your own Linear OAuth application, in which case its callback URLs must include the port chosen above.
